title: Texas Instruments Incorporated (NASDAQ: TXN) — Institutional Investment Dossier
holding_rationale: Exit all 6.7226 Schwab shares right away. The stake carries a $1,999.97 cost basis (~$297.50 per share) and a $1,773.09 value (-$226.88 or -11.34% loss, 2.36% weight). On November 20, TXN fell 7.70% on 16.82M shares (1.99x average volume) to close at $263.75. That drop broke the 50D SMA ($286.38), 30W SMA ($285.65), 200D SMA ($266.37), and 40W EMA ($264.22) in a US Downtrend. Only $1.75 (0.12x ATR14) remains above our prior $262.00 stop. Move 100% of proceeds into USD cash rather than risking a gap lower.

primer: Texas Instruments (TXN) holds a COMPOUNDER_PASS quality rating with 22.04% ROIC and 64.2% Q3 gross margin. KPI health stays PASS_WITH_WATCH on 12% top-buyer risk, ~50% China ship-to exposure, 194-day inventory, and a $499M merger fee. At $263.75 on November 20, TXN broke below its 50-day and 200-day averages into STAGE_4 inside a 10-distribution-day US Downtrend. We assign REJECTED (TREND, VALUATION; TIER_0) for new cash and EXIT_IMMEDIATELY on our 6.7226 Schwab shares into 100% cash.
